extracted.name: My mother's fatless sponge
extracted.description: This recipe was submitted by a Good Food member and has not been tested by our team.
instruction_lines: Sieve the flour, baking powder and cornflour together.
Seperate eggs and whisk egg whites until stiff.
Whisk egg yolks and then add them to the whites, whisk altogether.
Fold in flour, cornflour and baking powder and divide between the 2 tins.
